title: Smoke-run every workflow when ComfyUI is bumped - and give the engine bump a playbook
description: MPI-465 shipped a totally dead LTX to users for six days because a ComfyUI bump changed a return type under a custom node and NOTHING executes a workflow before release. The engine bump also has no skill and no playbook - mpi-bump-local-comfy only touches the BENCH at G:/ComfyUi, not node_lock's core pin. Build a smoke matrix that EXECUTES a minimal generation per workflow, and hang it off a real engine-bump playbook. SCOPE SPLIT (MPI-468, 2026-08-07): this card owns the GUARD - docs/playbooks/bump-engine/, the smoke runner, and the mpi-release refusal. The in-place upgrade path and the bump skill are MPI-457. Dispatch notes for a cold session are in brief.md; hand the agent MPI-468.
acceptance: A smoke run EXECUTES each workflow - validation alone would NOT have caught MPI-465, which threw at sampling start after the loaders ran
Locally it smokes whatever is INSTALLED and says plainly which models it skipped - never silently reports green for an unrun model
The full matrix has a home that owns every weight (Builder Pod volume), so local coverage gaps are not permanent
An engine-bump playbook exists and calls the smoke run as a gate; mpi-bump-local-comfy stays bench-only and is cross-referenced, not overloaded
The release flow refuses to ship a bumped engine with no smoke evidence

attention.reason: ONE FULL MATRIX away from clean evidence, and nothing else blocks it. The nvidia_pid crop is fixed and re-exported (9b631513); gate 9 sweeps all 34 graphs clean at MpiNodes 43a976fd via the 48188 engine; pod lock + python_deps in sync with v0.30.0. Costs a rented GPU so it needs the user present. Budget 330 GB of volume (12 models / 35 ops / 288.0 GB), not the old 320. Turn 'Stage all models on connect' back ON - the last matrix ran entirely on cold volume reads. NEVER --models: it overwrites smoke-evidence.json with only those models and trips the coverage check. Also owed to MPI-491: the GPU-image _download_hf rate on controlnet-union-flux.
